title: Section-ring reconstruction and lax direct image form a coherent exact comparison
statement:
Fix a coefficient universe and sites $(C,J),(D,K)$ small relative to it [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Use tensor abelian sheaves with tensor the sheafification of sectionwise $\otimes_{\mathbf Z}$ [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure], and assume sheafification exists and its local equivalences are monoidal. Let $F:C\to D$ be a functor for which precomposition sends $K$-sheaves to $J$-sheaves, and write $P_F H(V)=H(FV)$ for this direct image. Give $P_F$ its canonical lax monoidal structure induced by sheafification, with tensor and unit maps normalized by the actual sheafification units as in [lem-sfb-sheaf-pushforward-generator-comparison]. Let $R_C,R_D$ be commutative monoid objects in these tensor abelian-sheaf categories, and let $\psi:R_C\to P_FR_D$ be a morphism of monoid objects. Let $B_C,B_D$ be their reconstructed section-ring sheaves, and $E_C,E_D$ the fixed internal/sectionwise module equivalences [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence].

There is a unique morphism of ring sheaves $\phi_\psi:B_C\to P_FB_D$ whose additive map on sections is $\psi_V$ for every $V\in C$. Define $P^{\rm int}_{F,\psi}=\operatorname{Res}_\psi\operatorname{mapMod}(P_F)$ using [sk-def-sfb-transport, sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], and define $P^{\rm sec}_{F,\phi_\psi}$ on sectionwise module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by $(P^{\rm sec}N)(V)=N(FV)$ with action $r n=\phi_{\psi,V}(r)n$. There is a unique natural comparison
$$r_{F,\psi}:E_CP^{\rm int}_{F,\psi}\xrightarrow{\sim}P^{\rm sec}_{F,\phi_\psi}E_D$$
whose underlying sheaf map is the identity; its reconstructed section action is $r n=\psi_V(r)n$.

These comparisons are compatible with composition: for a third site $(H,L)$ satisfying the same size and sheafification assumptions, a functor $G:D\to H$ with the same sheaf-restriction property, a commutative monoid $R_H$, and $\theta:R_D\to P_GR_H$, let $K:C\to H$ be a functor with the same sheaf-restriction property together with a natural isomorphism $\kappa:K\xrightarrow{\sim}GF$ (for instance $K=GF$ and $\kappa=\mathrm{id}$), and let $c_\kappa:P_FP_G\xrightarrow{\sim}P_K$ be the induced isomorphism of abelian-sheaf direct images, $(c_\kappa H')(V)=H'(\kappa_V)$. Put $\chi=c_{\kappa,R_H}\circ P_F(\theta)\circ\psi:R_C\to P_KR_H$. Then $\phi_\chi=c_{\kappa,B_H}\circ P_F(\phi_\theta)\circ\phi_\psi$, and the square comparing $r_{K,\chi}$ with $P^{\rm sec}_{F,\phi_\psi}(r_{G,\theta})\circ r_{F,\psi}$ commutes using the internal and sectionwise direct-image compositors whose underlying sheaf isomorphism is $c_\kappa$. The identity-functor comparisons agree as well. Each $E_C$ and its quasi-inverse are additive exact equivalences: a sequence of internal module sheaves is exact if and only if its image under $E_C$ is exact, and conversely for the quasi-inverse.
